world.title: Trump says Iran will never have nuclear weapon
world.summary: Donald Trump stated that he is implementing measures to ensure Iran never acquires a nuclear weapon, claiming these actions should have been taken by previous US presidents. He acknowledged that while some may disagree with his approach, a significant number of people support it. Trump emphasized his commitment to preventing Iran from developing nuclear capabilities.

world.title: Judge orders Trump to give deposition in BBC lawsuit by December 11
world.summary: A U.S. judge has ordered former President Donald Trump to provide a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The ruling, issued by Judge Enjolique Lett in Miami, comes after the judge rejected requests for delays. Failure to comply with the deadline may result in sanctions against Trump.

world.title: Serbia elections: Nearly 150,000 people take to streets in massive rally against Aleksandar Vucic | In pics
world.summary: Approximately 150,000 supporters of Serbia's opposition student movement gathered in Belgrade to protest against President Aleksandar Vucic's 14-year rule. The rally, organized ahead of important parliamentary elections, was reported by the independent crowd-monitoring group, the Archive of Public Gatherings. The event reflects growing discontent among citizens regarding Vucic's leadership and the political climate in Serbia.

business.title: Stocks in news: Swiggy, Infosys, HPCL, eMudhra, Adani Power, Shriram Finance, Tata Motors and NLC India
business.summary: Indian equity markets continued to decline, with the Nifty 50 index dropping 124 points, or 0.54%, to close at 22,688. Analysts noted critical resistance and support levels amid ongoing selling pressure and negative global indicators. Several companies, including Swiggy, Infosys, and Tata Motors, reported mixed financial results for the September quarter, prompting market participants to remain cautious.

business.title: Government plans to pare stakes in 4 PSU banks to 75%
business.summary: The Union government plans to reduce its stakes in four public sector banks to 75% as part of its 2021-22 budget. This initiative includes the privatisation of IDBI Bank, along with two additional public sector banks and one general insurance company. The move aims to enhance efficiency and attract private investment in the banking sector.

business.title: Japan's core inflation exceeds BOJ target, cements near-term rate hike chance
business.summary: Japan's core consumer inflation surpassed the Bank of Japan's 2% target in September, marking the first instance in nine months. This increase indicates broadening price pressures, strengthening the argument for a near-term interest rate hike. The data, released on Friday, suggests that the central bank may need to adjust its monetary policy in response to rising inflationary trends.

technology.title: Tata Electronics wants bigger bite of Apple
technology.summary: Tata Electronics aims to increase its share of Apple's supply chain in India, according to industry sources. As the fourth-largest company within the Tata Group by revenue, Tata Electronics has established itself as a key supplier for Apple. The company's efforts to climb the value chain reflect its ambition to secure a more significant role in the industry.

technology.title: Dell releases new XPS 16 laptop globally with 1,600-nit OLED display and up to 128 GB RAM
technology.summary: Dell has launched its XPS 16 laptop globally, featuring a 1,600-nit OLED display, 18-core or 20-core Nvidia RTX Spark N1X chipsets, and up to 128 GB of RAM. The 20-core variant, priced from $3,999, includes a 6,144-core GPU and 1 TB of storage, while maintaining options for 32 GB or 64 GB of RAM.

technology.title: Oppo launches high-end compact OLED tablet with 144Hz matte display and Snapdragon chip
technology.summary: Oppo has launched the Pad Mini Matte Display Edition in India, with preorders available in Malaysia. This compact tablet features an 8.8-inch 144Hz OLED display, powered by a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor, 8GB of RAM, and 256GB of storage. The device was announced on October 14 and offers a resolution of 2,520 × 1,680 pixels.

sports.title: Five Bullet Points From Real Madrid’s Win Over RB Leipzig
sports.summary: Real Madrid secured a victory against RB Leipzig, prompting a series of observations about the match. Key points include insights into the club's history, player loan situations, and tactical strategies. This marks the 14th edition of the post-match analysis series, with previous editions available for reference. The commitment to this analysis format continues, providing relevant thoughts on the game.

sports.title: By the votes: Kooora's editors choose the Ballon d'Or winner
sports.summary: Kooora's editors conducted a special vote to predict the Ballon d'Or winner, reflecting voting trends in the Arab press. The award, presented by France Football, is highly regarded in football, recognizing individual excellence. As the nominations and predictions vary, the votes are the decisive factor in determining which player will be acknowledged for their achievements over the past year.

sports.title: Cummins: Australia can't 'paper over cracks' after innings thrashing
sports.summary: Australia's cricket team must evaluate their batting lineup following a significant defeat in the recent Test match. Captain Pat Cummins emphasized the need for serious changes, stating that the team was "nowhere near our best." The focus will shift to the upcoming deciding Test in Cape Town, where adjustments may be crucial for improving performance.

health.title: Know your normal: Small changes can sound the alarm for breast cancer
health.summary: Breast cancer is the second most common cancer among women in the U.S. Dr. Shane Thorp emphasizes the importance of annual screenings and understanding personal health norms. Women over 40 should consult their doctors about scheduling mammograms, which are crucial for early detection. Staying informed about changes in breast health can aid in timely diagnosis and treatment.

health.title: France Reports First Human Case of Livestock Virus Shamonda in Severely Ill Patient Who Later Died
health.summary: France has reported its first human case of the Shamonda virus in a severely immunocompromised patient who was undergoing treatment for a serious illness in Lyon. The patient, who was diagnosed with the virus, later died in early October. Health authorities confirmed the case, marking a significant development in understanding the virus's impact on human health.

health.title: A selfie as a health check? AI detects health risks and biological age from a facial photo
health.summary: Researchers have developed an AI model that estimates biological age and identifies health risks, including cancer, from facial photos. Evaluated on approximately 43,000 cancer patients, the model underwent further testing with 3,820 individuals, classifying 122 as high-risk. The study explores the model's effectiveness and the progress of the accompanying app in assessing health through facial analysis.

science.title: Seed Factories Come Pre-Assembled Before Sprouting Time
science.summary: Research reveals that seeds are pre-equipped with necessary machinery for germination, contrary to previous beliefs. This process resembles a computer, which remains inactive until powered on. Once activated, the seed utilizes its built-in components to initiate growth. Understanding this mechanism could enhance agricultural practices and improve crop yields, as it challenges traditional views on seed development.

science.title: Humanity's First Nuclear Fission-Powered Interplanetary Spacecraft to Send Three Helicopters to Mars
science.summary: NASA is advancing the development of the first nuclear fission-powered reactor for an interplanetary spacecraft. This initiative aims to enhance space exploration capabilities, particularly for missions to Mars. The project includes plans to send three helicopters to the planet, marking a significant milestone in space technology. The announcement follows a historic event, Ignition, which redefined aspects of the Artemis program.

science.title: Green Stars Should Not Exist, and Outside Astronomers Say Upcoming Surveys Could Find 10 or 20 More Like Warwick's Sodium-Tinted White Dwarf
science.summary: Astronomers have identified the first known green star, WD J1330+6435, challenging the belief that green stars do not exist. Researchers anticipate that upcoming surveys could discover 10 to 20 additional green white dwarfs. While the findings offer a fresh perspective on white dwarfs, some experts caution that it may not significantly enhance understanding of these celestial objects.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: October 23, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope for October 23, 2026, suggests that the cosmos is observant and ensures rewards align with intentions. Keeping an open heart is emphasized, as it enhances opportunities for positive experiences. The alignment of celestial bodies is believed to influence personal growth and relationships, encouraging individuals to remain receptive to the universe's guidance and embrace potential rewards.

entertainment.summary: Capricorns are encouraged to contemplate their next steps today, October 23, 2026.
